priority: Closing-line prediction and beating the close are the primary goals.

fields.raw_postgame_delta: Intermediate market-repricing prediction from the completed game.
fields.expected_market_close: Market baseline plus calibrated raw postgame delta.
fields.saturday_shadow_line: Official model plus a temporary adjustment validated primarily against the next closing line.
fields.opener_edge: Saturday shadow line minus opener, using consistent team perspective.
fields.expected_clv: Expected market close minus available opener, using consistent team perspective.

research_order: Measure expected CLV at the opener.
Track actual-score improvement as a secondary diagnostic.
